items.question: How long does a custom cover take?
items.answer: 1–3 weeks depending on project complexity. Premades are delivered in 1–2 weeks.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Revisions within the predefined plan are included. Additional changes beyond scope may have extra cost.

items.question: What's the payment process?
items.answer: 50% advance to start. Balance upon final design approval. We accept Western Union, bank transfer and cash.

items.question: What currency do you charge in?
items.answer: We charge in USD and guaraníes (₲). See our pricing table for both currencies.

items.question: Can I use the cover on Amazon KDP / Wattpad / publishers?
items.answer: Yes. Design rights belong to Dayah LitWorks until full payment. Once paid 100%, you can use the cover on any platform.

items.question: What is a 3D mockup?
items.answer: A realistic 3D render of your book. Perfect for social media promotion and marketing.

items.question: What if I cancel the project?
items.answer: If the client cancels after work has started, the advance payment is non-refundable.

items.question: Do you redesign existing covers?
items.answer: Yes, you can hire a redesign as a custom cover. Send us your current cover and new ideas.

items.question: What do I need to get started?
items.answer: Book title, synopsis, genre, visual references (ideas, fonts, colors, styles). Send references BEFORE requesting design.

items.question: What language do you design in?
items.answer: We design covers in Spanish and English. Typography adapts to your book's language.

items.question: Can I request rush delivery (48–72h)?
items.answer: Contact us on WhatsApp to check availability. Rush projects may have a surcharge.

items.question: How are final files delivered?
items.answer: High-resolution files (JPG, PDF, PNG) ready to upload to your platform. Mockups delivered as rendered images.

como-elegir-portada-libro.title: How to Choose the Perfect Book Cover
como-elegir-portada-libro.author: Dayah LitWorks
como-elegir-portada-libro.content:
Your book cover is the first impression a potential reader has of your work. In a world where thousands of books are published daily, your cover needs to stand out in seconds.

## 1. Know Your Genre
Every genre has visual conventions. Fantasy readers expect magical elements; thriller readers expect tension and mystery. Don't ignore these conventions — they're a shortcut for your audience to find you.

## 2. Typography Matters More Than You Think
70% of an effective cover is typography. The title must be legible at thumbnail size (that's how it appears on Amazon). Choose fonts that reflect your book's tone.

## 3. Less is More
The most effective covers have one clear focal point. Don't try to tell the entire story on the cover. One strong visual element + excellent typography = a cover that sells.

## 4. Test at Thumbnail Size
Your cover will appear at roughly 100x150px on most online stores. If it's not readable at that size, you need a redesign.

## 5. Invest in Professionalism
A professional cover is not an expense — it's an investment. It's the difference between your book looking like an amateur project or a serious publication.

---

*Ready to give your book the cover it deserves? [Contact me on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/595986868241) and let's talk about your project.*

seo.description: Meet Dayah, a book cover designer based in Asunción, Paraguay. 6+ years creating covers that sell.

bio.short: Book cover designer with 6+ years of experience. From Asunción, Paraguay, to authors worldwide.
bio.long:
I'm Daihana Araujo, founder of Dayah LitWorks. Since November 2019, I've been transforming manuscripts into covers that sell books.

I created Dayah LitWorks with the conviction that every book deserves a professional cover, regardless of the author's budget. I work with indie authors across the Spanish and English-speaking world, designing covers that capture the essence of each story.

My approach combines a deep understanding of literary genres with a collaborative creative process. I believe the best cover comes from listening to the author, understanding their vision, and translating it into a design that's not only beautiful but works as a sales tool.
